title: Bijection on algebra maps into the point
statement: Let A and B be commutative local rings in one universe and let π:A → B be surjective. Let K be a field with compatible A- and k(A)-algebra structures factoring A -> K through the residue field, as in [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Let H be the extension of scalars of [lem-sbc-surjective-quotient-base-change]. For every commutative A-algebra S, the map Hom_A(S,K) → Hom_B(H(S),H(K)) induced by H is bijective.

source.place: Tag 05WS, lemma-quotient-strict-henselization; trivial action of ker π on the residue-field point

proof.text: Descend A -> K along π, since its kernel is contained in the maximal ideal and hence killed in K. The cocone with vertex K and legs id and the descended B-map is a pushout. The canonical K -> H(K) is therefore an isomorphism.

Compose the explicit algebra/under-category equivalences with Under.mapPushoutAdj. Its unit at K has the canonical underlying pushout map and so is invertible. The hom equivalence and inverse unit give surjectivity on maps to K; naturality and cancellation of the unit at K give injectivity.
